en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a wide dirt road leading toward a complex of low buildings with East Asian architectural features (curved tiled roofs and gate structures). A flagpole with a flag stands in front of the central building. Other smaller structures and a tree are visible in the background. Printed caption text in Cyrillic and Latin script appears at the top left.
